Configuration

Panel defaults, the undo window, and the Telegram bot.

What a fresh install uses unless you say otherwise.
WhatDefault

New-user defaults30 days, 100 GB, 1 device

Undo window (25 seconds)

Deleting a user or a node is undoable for 25 seconds. The banner shows the Undo button and a ✕ dismiss button; both clear after 25 seconds. After that the snapshot expires and the restore API returns 410 Gone. Node restore re-inserts the node row only; per-user node_usage baselines are not resurrected and re-baseline on the next poll.

Telegram management bot

The bot is in-panel (long-poll from the panel, no external service) and inactive until Settings → Telegram holds a bot token and an owner chat ID. The token is stored encrypted and masked as ••last4.

  • User activation: owner creates a user in the panel and hands over an activation link of the form t.me/<bot>?start=<user-uuid>. A user taps Start to bind their chat to that account. Unbound chats see only the prompt to ask their operator for a link.
  • User commands (read-only): /me (status, used/limit, expiry), /ovpn (points to the panel subscription page). Users cannot extend, disable, or delete themselves.
  • Owner commands: /list, /extend <uuid|name> <days> [gb] (Stacks onto a future expiry, or counts from today). Owner is the chat in Settings → Telegram → Chat ID.
  • One-way alerts: node down/up, threshold alerts, and the daily summary use the same sender. Any Telegram failure returns false and never blocks panel work.
